services.title: Authentic Venetian Plaster
services.desc: Traditional multi-coat Venetian finishes with hand-polished marble dust and lime. Creates depth, warmth, and a luxurious glow that paint cannot match.

services.title: Modern Textured Designs
services.desc: Contemporary takes on Venetian technique—from subtle matte finishes to bold geometric patterns. Fully customisable to your interior style.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accents
services.desc: Statement Venetian plaster walls that anchor a room. Perfect for living rooms, bedrooms, and hallways that need character and impact.

services.title: Restoration & Repair
services.desc: Expert repair and finishing of damaged plaster walls. We match existing finishes seamlessly and refresh tired surfaces to like-new condition.

services.title: Commercial & Hospitality
services.desc: Bespoke Venetian finishes for hotels, restaurants, and boutique retail spaces. Durable, sophisticated, and designed to impress guests and customers.

services.title: Colour Consultation & Design
services.desc: Work with us to choose the perfect finish, texture, and colour palette. Our design service ensures your Venetian plaster complements your home's aesthetic.

about_pullquote: Every wall tells a story. Ours just happen to be beautifully finished.
about_para_1: Raffinato was born from a passion for authentic Venetian plaster craft and a frustration with mass-produced interiors. For over 15 years, we've specialised in bringing the timeless elegance of Venetian finishes to homes and commercial spaces across Leeds and beyond. Our founder trained directly with master plasterers in Venice and Northern Italy, learning techniques passed down through generations—knowledge we bring to every single project.
about_para_2: We don't do quick fixes or one-size-fits-all finishes. Every wall is a conversation between you, your space, and the plaster itself. Our clients return to us because they know the result will be stunning, durable, and uniquely theirs. We stand behind every finish with a comprehensive guarantee, and we're obsessive about detail—from surface preparation to the final polish.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Raffinato

reviews.text: We wanted something different for our living room and Raffinato was exactly what we needed. Marco came round, showed us samples, and talked us through the options without pushing us in any direction. The finished wall is absolutely stunning—way better than we imagined. Guests constantly ask what it is. Would 100% recommend.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Had a water-damaged wall that looked dreadful. Thought we'd have to repaint the whole room. Raffinato restored it and applied a new Venetian finish that blends perfectly with the existing plaster. The craftsmanship is seriously impressive. Not cheap, but absolutely worth every penny.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Our restaurant needed an upgrade. We contacted Raffinato for a couple of feature walls and they delivered exactly what we envisioned—sophisticated, elegant, and hard-wearing. Been open six months and the finishes look as fresh as day one. Highly professional from start to finish.
reviews.author: Priya K.
